generation.scope: All standard windows admitting an integral quadric cone quotient are classified by a dual-number spin matrix: three scalar-leading cases, a projective conjugacy family, and one alternating trace-zero case. All have exact period one and only the alternating case has the bare cone as its entire point graph. Every plane component with point projection fibers supplies a regular normal linear sequence. This covers every surface component in the finite-projection branch by a smooth quadric quotient, a cone quotient, or a normal linear plane quotient.
